added.statement: The live Factory custom-model catalog shall expose one MiniMax backup route backed by MINIMAX_BACKUP_API_KEY while existing MiniMax routes continue to use MINIMAX_API_KEY.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one custom model is named MiniMax Backup: MiniMax-M3

Existing MiniMax custom models continue to reference ${MINIMAX_API_KEY}

breaker.condition: the backup model is absent, duplicates the primary credential, changes an existing primary route, or leaks the backup key into tracked content

test_plan.description: The focused dotfiles contract test fails before the module exists and proves the declared import, managed command, registration conditions, enablement, restart policy, and unchanged Codex ownership after implementation.

The focused dotfiles contract test fails before provider-env support exists and then proves ordered SOPS-backed rendering, mode-0600 runtime output, environment injection, and absence of literal provider values in tracked source.
After applying the profile, systemd readback proves the service is active, the registered computer is present, and a controlled native-daemon termination causes the unit to restart.

After applying the profile, runtime readback proves the service process contains the MiniMax primary, MiniMax backup, Kimi, and Ollama variables without exposing their values and the provider env file is mode 0600.

Live Factory settings readback proves exactly one MiniMax backup custom model references MINIMAX_BACKUP_API_KEY, existing primary MiniMax models remain on MINIMAX_API_KEY, and the two credential values are distinct.
